description: Utility functions for user profile handling, role checking, and suggestions in Mattermost Redux, including name display, role verification, profile filtering, and suggestion generation.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of a user by concatenating first and last names if available.

methods.name: displayUsername
methods.description: Determines the display name for a user based on preferences and available user data.

methods.name: spaceSeparatedStringIncludes
methods.description: Checks if a specific item is included in a space-separated string.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if roles include system or team admin roles.

methods.name: isGuest
methods.description: Checks if roles include the system guest role.

methods.name: isTeamAdmin
methods.description: Checks if roles include the team admin role.

methods.name: isSystemAdmin
methods.description: Checks if roles include the system admin role.

methods.name: includesAnAdminRole
methods.description: Checks if roles include any recognized admin roles.

methods.name: isChannelAdmin
methods.description: Checks if roles include the channel admin role.

methods.name: hasUserAccessTokenRole
methods.description: Checks if roles include the user access token role.

methods.name: hasPostAllRole
methods.description: Checks if roles include the post all role.

methods.name: hasPostAllPublicRole
methods.description: Checks if roles include the post all public role.

methods.name: profileListToMap
methods.description: Converts a list of user profiles into a map keyed by user ID.

methods.name: removeUserFromList
methods.description: Removes a user from a list of user profiles by user ID.

methods.name: getSuggestionsSplitBy
methods.description: Generates suggestion strings by splitting a term with a delimiter.

methods.name: getSuggestionsSplitByMultiple
methods.description: Generates suggestions by splitting a term with multiple delimiters.

methods.name: nameSuggestionsForUser
methods.description: Creates a list of name-based suggestions for user search/autocomplete.

methods.name: filterProfilesStartingWithTerm
methods.description: Filters user profiles whose suggestions start with a given term.

methods.name: filterProfilesMatchingWithTerm
methods.description: Filters user profiles whose suggestions include a given term.

methods.name: sortByUsername
methods.description: Sorts user profiles alphabetically by username.

methods.name: checkUserHasRole
methods.description: Helper to verify if a user has a specific role considering membership and role type.

methods.name: applyRolesFilters
methods.description: Filters users based on inclusion/exclusion roles and membership.
